english.title: Sexual activity with a corpse - no penetration
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 70 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally
performed an act of touching
not involving penetration
with a part of your body / a thing
of a part of the body of a dead person
knowing / being reckless
as to whether that was what was touched and
that touching was sexual

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from 29th September 2026, replacing the previous offence provided by section 70 (see H5824) due to changes made by the Crime and Policing Act 2026. For the offence covering pentration, see H102804.
(ii) A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates' court, see section 70(2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
